verdict.rationale: Slack's Events API docs say it is "a streamlined way to build apps and bots that respond to activities in Slack". Apps subscribe to the events they want, and Slack pushes them either over a Socket Mode connection or to a public HTTP endpoint. Bolt frameworks and AsyncAPI specs for the Events API support building such bots. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time delivery, and explicit documentation of message event types and delivery guarantees in the evidence.
